question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Easy to understand
solution: The correct answer is "**Lucid**". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Let's look at the given options: • **Ambiguous**: having a double meaning or unclear meaning. • **Ludicrous**: ridiculous or absurd. • **Lucid**: expressed clearly; easy to understand. • **Lackluster**: lacking in vitality, force, or conviction; uninspired or uninspiring. • From the above meanings, we can gather that "**Lucid**" is the correct substitute for the given group of words. • Thus, ***option 3*** is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__** • Ambiguous: जिसका दोहरा अर्थ या अस्पष्ट अर्थ हो। • Ludicrous: हास्यास्पद या बेतुका। • Lucid: स्पष्ट रूप से व्यक्त; समझने में आसान। • Lackluster: जीवन शक्ति, बल, या दृढ़ विश्वास की कमी; अनुप्राणित। 43:T756, The correct answer is "**One casual leave per month can be taken.**"
